normal.name: Thalia Archibald
normal.text: What are some games that never redraw the screen—only draw additively—and can be represented as text or ASCII art? This is the class of games that can be played on a teletype, besides the obvious text adventures. With reverse line feed like the Teletype Model 37, a game board can be filled in, play by play. * Minesweeper * Picross * Sudoku * Voltorb Flip * crossword * regular expression crossword * virus war / Paper Tactics * tic-tac-toe * hangman #retrocomputing #retrogaming #teletype

normal.name: zeratul2099
normal.text: 30 years ago, we thought video games and movies will soon merge and be one and the same. With the rise of the CD-ROM, many games with actual movie clips appeared, most of them trash and the FMV genre vanished as fast as it appeared. But Wing Commander 3 and 4 managed it to be a great mix of movie and space sim. The first minute of WC4 - by Chris Roberts, who had a lot of Hollywood ambitions at that time. #wingcommander #wingcommander4 #retrogaming #retrocomputing #dosgaming #msdos #spacesim
normal.media: video: The intro of Wing Commander 4. It looks like a Hollywood space scifi movie, starring Mark Hamill, John Rhys-Davies, Tom Wilson and Malcom McDowell.
